administration.note: Reform UK is the largest single party (29 seats) with 32% share of 90 seats. Stephen Place took office as Leader on 19 May 2026 following the 7 May 2026 local elections. The council operates under no-overall-control. Reform's policy programme depends on building working majorities issue-by-issue.

capitalisation_direction_profile_gbp._note: Revised profile per Revenue Outturn 2025-26 Table 13 (Executive, 9 June 2026). The previous £569.9m profile was the March 2025 MTFS PLAN across seven years, not drawn borrowing. Bradford now expects to exit financial intervention during 2026/27 rather than 2028/29.

mtfs.intervention_status: MHCLG Best Value Notice + Capitalisation Direction (one tier below S114)
mtfs._source: Bradford Council Executive 4 March 2025 + Council 6 March 2025, MTFS 2025/26 to 2029/30 (Doc AY, s50461)

capitalisation_direction_superseded_prof._note: Improved from January 2025 projection (£640m total) via 9.99% council tax = -£70m + reduced borrowing -£11m. Returns to sustainability in 28/29 (two years earlier than January projection).

mtfs._recovery_note: Recovery period shortened: the council expects to come out of financial intervention during 2026/27, an improvement of two years on the previous 2028/29 expectation.

reform_operations.model: Cabinet-led, with BBERT (Bradford Budget Emergency Response Team) as officer-led monitoring vehicle

centralised_savings.executive_director: Steven Mair, Interim Strategic Director of Corporate Resources (S151)
functions: MHCLG Best Value Notice + Capitalisation Direction interface
Improvement Board (statutory under BVN) monthly engagement
Cashflow improvements (BCFT working capital, WYCA, BCF)
Pension contribution windfall (GBP 7.2m, WYPF rate 16.2% to 12.3%)

savings_pipeline.note: Risk-adjusted central EV at 28/29 is GBP 47.09m (80% CI GBP 45.56m - GBP 48.63m). Covers 147% of the residual gap above inherited multi-year programme continuation.
